# Studio: merge dashboards into apps (apps-only model)

## Context

Ben's UX feedback as a builder: it is confusing to have a "dashboard" that feels like a half-object next to an "app". In practice dashboards *can* be published alone today (`/d/{id}`, launcher card), but the app builder cannot create one, every app-builder hint talks about publishing the dashboard "to publish this app", and the two sidebar entries read as peers with no stated relationship. Decision (2026-10-16, final): **remove dashboards as a concept. Apps are the only thing builders and viewers interact with.** A "dashboard" becomes an app whose page is a free-form chart canvas; a "full app" is the same thing plus text, buttons, assistants, workflows and more pages.

Decisions already taken with Ben:

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Canvas model | **Hybrid.** Pages keep the sections model (ACM-1176/1175). A third section kind, **canvas** (`container` + `layout.mode='grid'`), is the old dashboard grid: drag-move, resize, select. A **new app opens with one Home page holding one empty canvas section**, so a pure dashboard never asks the builder to think about sections. |
| Reusing a chart from another app | **Copy** the chart spec into this app (new component id). No live cross-app references, no second publish step. |
| Dashboards UI/API/tables | **Remove entirely.** No hidden fallback. |
| Existing dev data | **Drop.** Alembic drops dashboard tables; apps that embedded dashboards lose those components and are reset to draft. No migration of demo assets. |
| Environments | Studio is deployed to `aimfg-dev` only (`acm-kubernetes-manifest/studio/aimfg-dev.yaml`), so no UAT/prod data to protect. |

Why not "whole page is a free canvas" (discussed and rejected): text/buttons/forms have natural heights and clip on a fixed-row grid; a 48-col absolute canvas has no responsive reflow (ACM-1166/1171 class of bugs); the AI builder is measurably worse at x/y than at rows/columns (that is why ACM-1176 moved to native sections); and it discards the sections work shipped this week for no gain on mixed pages.

## Target model (one sentence each)

- **App** = pages + shared components + theme, as today. `apps` table and `app_versions` remain the only Studio content tables.
- **Chart** = a new component type (`type: 'chart'`) carrying the old `DashboardWidget` spec (sql, chart_type, option, data_mapping, grid, refresh_override, alerts). The `table` component type folds into `chart_type='table'`. `dashboard` and `widget` component types are deleted.
- **Canvas section** = `container` with `layout.mode='grid'`, `cols=12`, children are charts (and possibly other leaves later) with absolute x/y/w/h, edited with react-grid-layout exactly as the dashboard builder does today.
- **Page filters + refresh** = `Page.filters: FilterDef[]` and `Page.refresh_interval_sec` (ported from `Dashboard.filters` / `refresh_interval_sec`); a FilterBar sits at the top of the page in builder and viewer, and `{{key}}` placeholders in chart SQL bind as today.
- **Publish** = unchanged lifecycle (draft / published / unpublished, versions, rollback). `app_versions.spec` now *is* the freeze for charts; `frozen_assets` keeps only workflows.
- **AI builder** = one builder. The dashboard builder's SQL tools (`describe_available_data`, `run_query`), its "every SQL must have been run this turn" verification, and its chart placement rules merge into the app builder prompt and tool loop.
- **Viewer** = `/launcher` lists apps only; `/a/{id}` renders canvas sections with the published chart grid; `/d/*` is gone.

## 1. Critique of the target design

Overall the design is sound. The items below are where I would change it, in order of impact.

### (a) `chart` as a typed `Component` field — right call, with three fixes

Typed field is correct: `ChartSpec` already carries validators that must run on every ingest path (`strip_unsafe_option` on `option`, the ACM-1184 heatmap re-mapping, `_LLMModel` null/scalar coercion). `props: dict[str, Any]` would bypass all of them, and `_sanitise_props`/`_sanitize_component` only filter keys, never values. Rollback (`store._restore_content` → `App.model_validate(spec)`) and the builder (`_spec_to_app` → `App.model_validate`) get validation for free.

Fixes needed:
1. **Split display from data.** Keep `props` for display (`title`, and for `chart_type='table'`: `decimals`, `columnFormats`, `limit`, `columns` — i.e. today's `table` allowlist) and put only authoring/data in `chart` (`chart_type`, `sql`, `option`, `data_mapping`, `refresh_override_sec`, `alerts`). Drop `ChartSpec.grid` and `ChartSpec.title`: position is `Component.grid` on the canvas (12 cols), title is `props.title`. This keeps `assist_component_props` and `PropertiesPanel` on the existing props contract and keeps SQL out of the props-assist LLM call entirely.
2. **`tree._MERGE_KEYS` must include `chart` with a deep merge** (`data_mapping`/`option` merge key-wise, like `dashboards/builder._deep_merge`). Otherwise a `<component_patch>` `update` of `{"chart": {"data_mapping": {"unit": "%"}}}` wipes `sql`. Port `_deep_merge` into `app/apps/tree.py`.
3. **Chart only on `type='chart'`.** Add a model validator that sets `chart = None` for other types (mirrors the agent-binding drop at `models.py:434`) and gives a chart component a default empty `ChartSpec` (sql `""`) so the "empty placeholder" primitive round-trips. Publish, not save, refuses `sql == ""`.

SQL verification cannot live in the model; it goes in `AppBuilder._parse_build_or_patch` before `_spec_to_app`: flatten proposed chart components, compare with `tree.flatten(current)` by id, port `_needs_verification` (new/changed `sql` not in `ctx.verified_sql` → drop new chart, keep current version of existing, append `_verification_feedback` and loop once, exactly as `DashboardBuilder._run_turn` does today).

### (b) Resolver cache keys and invalidation

`CacheKey = (mode, project_id, cache_scope, sha256(bound_sql))` is already app-ready. `_by_dashboard`/`_Entry.dashboards`/`_Flight.dashboards` are just the invalidation handle; rename to `owners` and `invalidate_owner(owner_id)` with `owner_id = app_id`. Scopes: draft → `""` (per-project, builder bearer, as dashboards drafts today), published → `app_cache_scope(app_id, version_no)` (unchanged). The real gap: **the apps router never invalidates today** (it didn't own SQL). PR A must call `invalidate_owner(app_id)` on PUT, publish, unpublish, rollback, delete; `projects.delete_project` keeps `invalidate_project`. TTL: `_ttl(chart.refresh_override_sec, page.refresh_interval_sec)`.

Drop the `Dashboard` param and `Dashboard.model_validate(spec)` inside the resolver.

1. **`chart` is a typed field on `Component`, not props.** `Component.props` is only key-filtered by `_sanitise_props`; `ChartSpec` needs value validators (`strip_unsafe_option`, heatmap remap from ACM-1184, `_LLMModel` null coercion) on every ingest path (PUT, builder proposal via `_spec_to_app`, rollback via `App.model_validate`). Split: **display** stays in `props` (`title`, and for `chart_type='table'` the old table allowlist `decimals/columnFormats/limit/columns`), **data** goes in `chart` (`chart_type, sql, option, data_mapping, refresh_override_sec, alerts`). Position is `Component.grid`. A validator nulls `chart` on non-chart types (like the agent-binding drop at `app/apps/models.py:434`) and defaults an empty spec on chart types so the "empty chart" placeholder round-trips; **publish**, not save, refuses `sql == ""`.
2. **`tree._MERGE_KEYS` (`app/apps/tree.py:29`) must add `chart` with a deep merge**, otherwise a builder `<component_patch>` that updates `chart.data_mapping.unit` wipes `sql`. Port `_deep_merge` from `app/dashboards/builder.py:314`.
3. **SQL verification moves into `AppBuilder._parse_build_or_patch`**: flatten proposed chart components, diff by id against `tree.flatten(current)`, drop/keep + feedback + one retry exactly as `DashboardBuilder._run_turn` does (`_needs_verification`, `_verification_feedback`, `ctx.verified_sql`). SQL copied verbatim from a `discover_assets` result is pre-verified. Keep the hostile-tool-text test.
4. **Resolver**: `CacheKey = (mode, project_id, cache_scope, sha256(bound_sql))` is already app-ready. Rename the per-dashboard handle to `owners` / `invalidate_owner(app_id)`. **The apps router never invalidates today** (it never owned SQL): PR A must invalidate on PUT, publish, unpublish, rollback, delete. Draft scope `""` + builder bearer; published scope `app_cache_scope(app_id, version_no)` unchanged. TTL = `chart.refresh_override_sec` else `page.refresh_interval_sec`.
5. **Filters are page-level.** Publish validates every `{{key}}` (`filters.placeholder_keys`) in a chart's SQL against its own page's filters; keys unique per page; charts in `shared_components` may not use placeholders (refuse at publish). Filter values live in the URL via `viewerState.filterValuesFromQuery/ToQuery`.
6. **Data paths**: keep `POST /apps/{id}/published/data {component_ids?, filter_values}` → `{version_no, components:{cid: ChartData}}` (simpler than today, one chart per cid, `appDataBatcher` untouched). Add `POST /apps/{id}/data` for the builder (edit gate, builder bearer, stored draft) mirroring `/dashboards/{id}/data`. Keep the builder-chat preview injection (`ResolverPreviewer`) for newly proposed charts.
7. **Canvas inside the sections editor**: `SectionEditor` already isolates drag (`Reorder.Item dragListener={false}`, grip-only `dragControls.start`), and react-grid-layout drags only from `.rgl-drag-handle`. **Do not render canvas children through `FilledSlot`**: it wraps previews in `pointer-events-none` (`SlotContent.tsx:216`), which would kill RGL drag/resize and `cardGesture` selection. A canvas band renders `ChartGrid editable` directly. RGL sets container height from layout, so `useElementHeight` (ACM-1180/1190) keeps working. If framer `layout` animation fights RGL transforms during section reorder, render the canvas band with `layout={false}`. Page-level Delete/Backspace needs a "selected is a canvas child" branch; a layout commit is one discrete undo step.
8. **Canvas is 12 columns, fixed.** `DraggableGrid` is 12/6/2 with 80 px rows, `deriveLayout` clamps to 12, the AI's sizing vocabulary is 12-based. `APP_GRID_COLS=48` stays only for nested grid containers inside slots and `LegacyBand`/`ContainerView`.
9. **Dev must not break between PRs.** If PR A removed `dashboard/widget/table` from `ComponentType`, every stored dev app embedding one would 500 on GET (`store._from_row` → `App.model_validate`) until the migration runs. So **PR A only adds `chart`; PR C removes the legacy types together with migration 0005.** Dev applies migrations automatically via the `db-migrate` init container in `acm-kubernetes-manifest/studio/aimfg-dev.yaml` (`alembic upgrade head`).
10. **AI builder regressions to pre-empt**: `_app_has_content` (`app/apps/builder.py:503`) returns True for a page with one empty canvas section → the guided interview would never arm. Redefine content as "any component that is not a section container and not an empty slot". `_SYSTEM_PROMPT` says grid mode is only for containers inside a slot and `_render_selection` hard-codes 48 cols → add the canvas as a third root section preset (`mode:'grid', cols:12`) and a canvas branch in `_render_selection` (resize = `grid`, never `flow`). `normalize_page_to_sections` currently wraps a grid root as a slot of a column section → invert (grid root = canvas, coerce cols to 12). Flip `grounding_tools_section(include_data_tools=True)` and reword "widget" → "chart". Raise `MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` default to 16 (three tools now).
11. **Table rendering**: `ViewerTableEmbed`/`BuilderTableEmbed` hold the columns/formats/limit logic; it moves into `ChartCard` for `chart_type==='table'` reading `props`.

Defaults chosen (change if you disagree): chart cap 24 per page; `/apps/assets` returns other apps' chart specs including SQL (edit-gated, the builder saw SQL in the dashboard builder anyway); a page that is a single canvas renders without band chrome so a pure dashboard never shows "Section 1", with "+ Add section" below.
